# Conversion rate optimization (Marketing Skills)

Reviews a page or form and suggests changes and experiments to lift conversions.

- Source: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills/main/skills/cro/SKILL.md
- Author: Corey Haines
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/conversion-rate-optimization-marketing-skills-ddce271b

When a page or form isn't converting, Claude assesses it against a CRO framework covering value proposition, headline, CTA, social proof, objections and friction, then gives prioritized recommendations and test ideas. It has specific frameworks for homepages, landing, pricing and feature pages, plus form optimization. Works even if you just share a URL.

**Try asking:**
- "This landing page isn't converting, what should I change?"
- "Audit our demo request form for friction"
- "Give me A/B test ideas for the pricing page"
